name: Prism · Refraction
description: White light in. Every color out. The design language for Prism web, terminal and Stream Deck surfaces.

day.ink: C = 0.15, L solved for 4.9:1 on --panel2 (so ≥4.5 on every Day surface)
day.sheen: L = 0.74 + 0.07·bump(h,100°,50°), C = 0.13 — decorative gradients only (--rf-spectrum in Day)

definition.lambda: λ = dominant wavelength (CIE 1931, D65) of the Night vivid color; purples show the complementary wavelength with a "c" suffix.

surfaces.note: prism-deck — the warm amber of a lit key.

galleries.rule: One λ per gallery across surfaces. Web: gallery hue = even steps along the spectrum in web navigation order, t = (order-1)/17 over PAGES. Terminal (prism-term galleries.js): a gallery with a web counterpart (same id, or status → notify, diagrams → arch) takes the hue and λ of that web gallery; terminal-only galleries take half-steps t = (k+½)/17 that no web gallery uses, spread evenly in terminal nav order. Every λ label names one gallery. If a nav order changes, regenerate.

family.sans: Inter, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
family.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, "Cascadia Mono", "Segoe UI Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
family.note: Inter is bundled at 400, 600 and 700 (Latin subsets in design/fonts/) — in Prism.html, self-hosted on the website, inlined in the specimen. font-synthesis stays off. No web fonts from CDNs.

weight.note: Use only the three real faces: 400, 600, 700. In-between values snap to a face (500 → 400, 650 → 700) — never use them.

hero.use: Fluid landing display — the website hero h1 on large screens (~88px at 1440, 112px from 1920)

section.use: Section headings on large screens — website h2s, library page headers (fluid 40 → 48px; 48 from 1920px)

count.use: Counts and λ in nav, chips

radius.note: Website radii are 8 / 12 / 16. Buttons + inputs md, tiles lg, panels/dialogs xl.

density.note: Contract --dens multiplies vertical padding in chrome.

duration.note: firstLight is a ceiling owned by design/first-light/.

easing.note: Arrivals use out-expo; exits use in at ~60% of the arrival duration; continuous loops use linear or in-out.

stagger.note: Cascade at most 12 items (336ms); everything after arrives with the 12th.

patterns.refract-in: Converge: opacity 0→1, translateY 6px→0, blur 6px→0, a ±3px red/blue chromatic split resolving to 0. 600ms out-expo. Headers and hero type.
patterns.rise: Tiles: opacity 0→1, translateY 10px→0, scale .985→1. 400ms out-expo, staggered 28ms. The tile top edge carries a 1px fringe glint that fades.
patterns.beam-sweep: A 1px beam travels the long axis once (600ms in-out). Theme switch relight, progress, copy confirmation.
patterns.glint: A diagonal spectral glint crosses a lit edge once on hover (600ms out).
patterns.theme-relight: Day <-> Night: View Transition; the new theme is revealed behind a vertical beam that travels away from the toggle that was pressed (origin right of centre → right-to-left; no origin → left-to-right). 600ms in-out, a ceiling. Any input (pointerdown, keydown, wheel, touchstart) ends it at once. Fallback: 240ms cross-fade. Implemented by PrismFirstLight.relight(applyFn, originEl) in design/first-light/.
patterns.reduced: prefers-reduced-motion: every pattern becomes a 120ms opacity fade or no animation; no translation, blur, sweep or loop. First Light is skipped entirely.

elevation.note: Depth from light, not shadow: each level adds light to the top edge and a little lift to the fill. Only overlays (level 3) cast a real shadow.

terminal.note: ANSI-16 schemes for Night/Day terminals with the 16-color slot of each token (roles: [text, fill], -1 = the terminal default); designed xterm-256 indexes (tokens256, spectrum256 = spectrum ink, galleries256 = galleries.terminal ink/vivid, ansi16[].xterm256); truecolor = the hex values. surfaces256 = the backgrounds 256-color text sits on.

guidance.depth: Detect in order: NO_COLOR → none; COLORTERM=truecolor|24bit → truecolor; TERM=*256color* → 256; else 16. Never guess truecolor from TERM alone.
guidance.mode: Night is the default. Query OSC 11 (background color) with a 100ms timeout; else parse COLORFGBG; L(bg) > 0.6 → Day palette.
guidance.truecolor: Use the hex tokens and the spectrum tiers directly (night.ink / night.vivid; day.ink / day.vivid). Gradients interpolate in OKLCH, not RGB.
guidance.x256: Surfaces map to the nearest 16–255 index by OKLab distance. Text (ink tiers, text tokens) uses the designed index: the nearest if it clears 4.5:1 on every surfaces256 entry, else the hue-faithful nearest that does; marks (vivid ticks) the same at 3:1. Art and gradients stay plain nearest. Do not use 0–15 for brand hues — users remap them.
guidance.x16: Only semantic slots: 5 magenta = Prism violet (accent), 2 green = pos, 3 yellow = warn, 1 red = neg, 4 blue = info, 8 bright black = dim text. Gallery hue → hueToAnsi16.
guidance.dim: Use SGR 2 (faint) only on top of color 7/15; many terminals ignore it — prefer explicit dim color (8 / tokens256.dim).
guidance.shipping: Ship as Windows Terminal, iTerm2, Alacritty, kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty and Xresources files named "Prism Night" / "Prism Day".

deck.note: Author every key at 144×144 (@2x); the 72×72 render is a straight downsample. Units below are @144 with the @72 value in parentheses.

safe.note: Bezel may crop the outer 8px (4). Nothing essential outside 12px (6); text inside 16px (8).

micro.note: Non-essential only (λ, coordinates). Never the only label.

type.minimum: Nothing below 16px @144 (8 @72). Arm's-length legibility: labels 22px+ @144, values 40px+ @144.

material.note: Hardware LCD keys default to Night (no glare in a dark room); Day is offered as a profile option.

deck.hue: Each key carries its gallery hue as the spectral index: a 4px (2) bar, 32px (16) wide, centered 12px (6) above the bottom edge. Active state lights the whole edge in the hue.

on.glow: radial hue wash 22% from the bottom

alert.glow: breathes 1 Hz (opacity .55↔1), max 10 s, then holds
alert.shape: corner notch (24px triangle, top-right) — never color alone

busy.edge: a white beam segment travels the perimeter, 1.2 s per lap, 10 fps

deck.frameRate: Animate at ≤10 fps with precomputed frames; static keys between interactions. Reduced motion (plugin setting): no loops; busy = static three-dot glyph.
